title: Currencies
intro: Zoo 2: Animal Park has several types of currencies: Coins, Diamonds, Energy, Tickets, Keys, Feathers, and seasonal event currencies. These currencies can be used to purchase items and start upgrades.
coins_body: Coins are the basic currency in Zoo 2: Animal Park. They are easy to earn and can be used to purchase animals, buildings, decorations, most upgrades, enclosures, enclosure extensions, normal chests, and park expansions (plots).
generating_coins_intro: Coins can be earned in many ways in the game:
coin_body_1: Shops and entrance booths generate coins from visitors – the more visitors, the faster they fill up.
coin_body_2: Quests and the Mayor Zoo Title rewards almost always give coins for completion.
coin_body_4: Monthly reward paths typically give coins on the first login of the new month.
coin_body_6: Shell games can include coin prizes.
coin_body_7: Season pass levels can include coins.
coin_body_8: Selling certain coin animals is the best way to generate income: breed expensive coin animals and sell those you don't need. The selling price starts at 20% of the purchase price and increases by 5% with each species level up. Important: Make sure to safely house the highest level pair of each color so you don't accidentally sell them.
coin_body_9: Selling other items also generates coins at 20% of the purchase price, so it doesn't generate profit. Important note: Even diamond items can be sold for coins, which is a very poor exchange rate.
coin_body_10: Exchanging diamonds for coins is considered the worst practice, but is available in the game. Coins cannot be exchanged back for diamonds.
spending_coins_body: Almost everything in the game that can be purchased with coins goes on sale at some point. Normal chests (blue coin chests), club donation drives, and equipment repairs are never on sale. Patient players can wait for a discount on the desired item. Some players collect as many coins as possible to donate them in club competitions when their team is playing a coin animal. Others use coins for fertility food to increase the chances of successful breeding. Many save coins for events to get all items using the buy-collect-sell trick.
diamonds_body: Diamonds are Zoo 2's premium currency and can be earned through gameplay and giveaways, or purchased with real money. Various animals, decorations, plot expansions, breeding spots, chest keys, area unlocks, and certain buildings require diamonds. This currency is much harder to obtain than coins, but there are several ways to earn free diamonds and some opportunities to purchase them wisely with real money.
free_diamonds_gameplay_body: Conservation Week (every ~9 weeks) can give diamonds for personal placement, global community placement, and for certain quests.
free_diamonds_level_up_body: The game gives at least one diamond for reaching the next level; levels ending in 5 give 5 diamonds; levels ending in 0 give the corresponding value in diamonds (max. 100).
free_diamonds_calendar_body: Daily logins give diamond rewards on some days of the month – logging in more than 25 days rewards one or two diamonds daily.
free_diamonds_season_pass_body: The free standard season pass can give diamonds for certain levels.
free_diamonds_quest_body: Quests sometimes reward diamonds upon completion, especially the Zoo Title quests.
watching_ads_body: Video ads at the entrance billboard of the main zoo can generate up to 2 diamonds per day. Watching 10 ads earns one diamond. After watching 20 ads, you must wait 24 hours. Saving up 1,000 videos and then redeeming them can also earn a premium animal. Saving 2,000 can earn two premium animals. 10,000 ads can result in a VIP bonus option.
news_subscriptions_body: Upjers sometimes releases promotional codes for free diamonds on social media or in the newsletter. Codes can be personalized single-use or universal. Subscribe to Zoo 2 Facebook, Zoo 2 Instagram, Upjers WhatsApp, Upjers Telegram, and the Upjers/Zoo 2 newsletters to stay up to date. By subscribing to the Uppy Bot on Telegram, you can earn 1 diamond for every 10 news announcements. Get 10 diamonds for your first subscription, then approximately 2 diamonds per month.
social_media_body: Upjers Discord, Facebook, and Instagram host competitions where 20–100 diamonds can be won. Discord competitions take place almost weekly. By joining the official Upjers Discord server, you can earn 1 diamond for every 10 thumbs-up reactions on news posts – up to 2 diamonds per month.
upjers_portal_body: From time to time, Upjers hosts community events where players can open a calendar door to reveal a code or redeemable link for premium currency – typically up to 20 diamonds per event. The Upjers forum occasionally holds competitions. Those with an Upjers account at upjers.com can collect points through daily logins and exchange them for diamonds (200 points = 2 diamonds each). Windows users can download Upjers Home for double points.
spending_body: The best time to spend diamonds is during a cashback event. Maximize the diamonds you get back by spending 2,000 or more diamonds during the event. The biggest sales tend to happen in mid-spring (around May) and mid-autumn (end of November). Almost everything purchasable with diamonds goes on sale at some point – except for breeding spots, chest keys, entrance booth upgrades, and Zoo Academy subscriptions.
buying_diamonds_body: Diamonds can be purchased with real money. Diamond packages of 100+ diamonds typically include at least one exclusive bonus animal with its enclosure. The price of diamond packages depends on the platform and the player's country as well as the current promotion. Players can buy diamonds in bundles of 10, 30, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1,000, and 2,500. When buying 100 or more diamonds, bundles often include bonus diamonds and/or bonus animals. Standard prices vary by platform and country. Steam, Epic, Apple App Store, and Google Play prices may differ from browser prices.
deal_special_guest_body: A permanent offer for an exclusive special guest NPC is available to players with every real money purchase. Limit one per offer. Offers run for about a year before switching to a new NPC. Diamonds earned from video ads, gameplay, subscriptions, and giveaways do not count.
deal_piggy_bank_body: A limited-time offer for players who have never purchased the piggy bank deal. Spend 5,000 coins in the game to fill the piggy bank, and purchase 100 diamonds at about 60% off. Bonus animal not included. Limit once per account.
deal_welcome_body: Players who have never purchased diamonds can receive 100–120% bonus diamonds for the 50, 100, or 200 diamond packages in the browser. Special guest bonus included. This offer comes once a year and is typically only available for one week.
deal_fun_fiesta_body: Up to 400% off – gives 50 diamonds for the price of 10 diamonds. Bonus animal not included. Limit once per promotional offer. This deal comes about twice a year and is only available for one week. It is recommended to only buy the small package with this deal.
deal_bunny_bite_body: Save up to $50 – Diamond packages are offered without excess bonus diamonds, resulting in an overall lower price. Ideal for players who want bonus animals without spending as much. Comes about twice a year, available for one week.
deal_voucher_body: Code for 300 premium currency – Offered exclusively in the browser version. Diamond packages give you half the bonus diamonds and the other half in a redemption code that you can share with a friend or use yourself. Redeeming vouchers of 100+ diamonds gives a bonus animal and its enclosure. Comes once or twice a year.
deal_star_savings_body: Up to 101% more – The best deal in terms of price per diamond. For approximately the same price as the normal 1,000+ diamond package, you can buy 2,010 diamonds distributed as 67 diamonds per day for 30 days. Limit once per package per offer. Comes once or twice a year, available for one week.
deal_55_body: A frequent offer with various promotion names, such as Spring Bonus, Midsommar, Buzzing Bonus, Autumn Bonus, and Shimmering Skies.
deal_60_body: A frequent offer with various promotion names, such as Summer Bonus, Happy Hearts, and Winter Bonus. The loyalty package available only in the browser is also the same offer for 200, 500, and 1,000 packages.
tickets_body: Tickets are a permanent special currency used to complete puzzle pieces. The current ticket balance is visible on the puzzle pieces screen. Tickets can be obtained from the monthly reward calendar path, by scrapping unwanted puzzle pieces, by spinning the lucky wheel, from season pass level rewards at any tier, and rarely from some special quests and zoo title rewards.
tickets_sale_body: When the treasure chest sale is available, tickets have an active 15% bonus – this causes a 15% increase when disassembling tickets and a 15% discount when completing missing puzzle pieces.
keys_body: Keys are used to reveal additional cards when opening chests. Each chest contains eight cards, but only the first four card reveals are free. Each additional card reveal uses one key. Keys can be obtained from the monthly reward calendar path, season pass level rewards at any tier, purchases for diamonds in the open chest window, sometimes purchasable with feathers in the season pass shop, and often from shell games as a free reward prize.
keys_tip_body: You can check how many keys you have by opening any chest or hovering over the key reward in the daily login calendar or in the season pass reward path.
energy_body: Energy is represented by the lightning bolt symbol and is used to operate the bulldozer and terrain editor. Energy can be obtained from the monthly reward calendar path, by spinning the lucky wheel, occasionally from quests or zoo title rewards, and from purchases for diamonds in the bulldozer or terrain editor windows.
feathers_body: Feathers are exclusive to the Season Pass and allow you to change the enclosure floor coloring. Feathers can be obtained from season pass level rewards at any tier and from purchases for diamonds in the season pass shop.
event_currency_body: During seasonal events, special decorations are available for a limited time purchasable with coins or diamonds. Events consist of a collection phase and a redemption phase. During the collection phase, you buy special decorations and collect event currency. Once the collection phase ends, decorations complete their countdown and generate a final collection – after that, no new currency-generating decorations can be purchased. The redemption phase lasts seven days after the end of the collection phase – collected event currency can still be spent, with the option to exchange additional event currency for diamonds.
event_tip_body: Event currency is NOT kept beyond the duration of the special event. All unspent event currency disappears after the completion of the redemption phase.
